newsitem.title: USA: Clinton signs $5.1 bln FY-97 spending bill for D.C.
newsitem.headline: Clinton signs $5.1 bln FY-97 spending bill for D.C.

text.p: President Clinton signed a $5.1 billion fiscal year 1997 spending bill for the financially troubled District of Columbia.
The compromise bill, which got final approval by the U.S. Senate September 5 and the House August 1, orders the city to cap its deficit at $74 million for the fiscal year beginning Oct. 1.
Originally the House demanded that the city slash its projected $99 million FY-97 deficit by $59 million to $40 million. But Senate panelists would only agree to a $25 million cut.
